verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent is a built-in AI assistant to which users delegate tasks (search, table-column extraction, drafting, skills for repeatable workflows) with adjustable effort levels, well documented across docs-2/8/11/12/13/16/21/23. Community hands-on use confirms it works for literature tasks (elicit-comm-1) but also reports notable accuracy/hallucination issues (elicit-comm-2,3,4,7), which affects reliability though not the existence of the delegation capability itself. Missing for 10: independent verification of agent reliability at scale and no dispute-level evidence that delegation itself fails.
